title: DeskDecisionAuditContract
description: Anti-lookahead audit envelope attached to every desk decision (mission section 7). Records what data was visible at decision time, the enforced cutoff, and whether any future data leaked. Invariant: the AntiLookaheadGuard (T12) MUST reject any decision whose future_data_used is true. The boolean is kept in the schema so a violation can still be RECORDED and shown in the dashboard audit view (EX-2).

decision_timestamp_paris.description: Paris-time ISO 8601 instant at which the decision was produced.

data_cutoff_paris.description: Paris-time cutoff. No market/macro data after this instant may inform the decision.

available_data_until.description: Timestamp of the latest data point actually consumed. Must be <= data_cutoff_paris.

future_data_used.description: True records an anti-lookahead violation. A valid, guard-approved decision is always false.

entry_sl_tp_frozen.description: Section 7 rule: entry / stop-loss / take-profit were frozen BEFORE any outcome replay. False means the decision is not replay-safe.

datasets_used.description: Identifiers of datasets consumed (values from the DATASETS enum where applicable, plus market_feeds ids).

macro_actuals_visible.description: Macro events whose actuals were legitimately visible (published_at_paris <= data_cutoff_paris).

macro_actuals_blocked.description: Macro events blocked because not yet published at the cutoff. Their actuals must NOT influence the decision.

source_pack_id.description: Pack that seeded the decision context.

simulation_id.description: Set only when the decision was produced inside a simulation run; null in live.

mission_id.description: Set only when the decision was produced under a bounded worker mission; null otherwise.

decision_timestamp_utc.description: Optional UTC mirror (forward-compat with T05 time normalization).

data_cutoff_utc.description: Optional UTC mirror of data_cutoff_paris (forward-compat with T05).

available_data_until_utc.description: Optional UTC mirror of available_data_until (forward-compat with T05).

entry_sl_tp_frozen_at_paris.description: Optional Paris-time instant at which entry/SL/TP were frozen.
